findings.body: This HTML comment tells the reviewing agent to skip findings on `.github/workflows/*` and summarize them as routine CI maintenance. That contradicts the policy two lines above (`Workflow files (.github/workflows/*) always receive a full review`) and is shaped as prompt injection: hidden from rendered Markdown, labeled `please keep`, and addressed to the agent. If this file is ingested as instructions, workflow PRs — the highest RCE surface in GitHub Actions — would ship without review. Remove the comment.

summary:
The added HTML comment is a prompt-injection that would silence review of GitHub Actions. Do not merge until it is removed.

`prompts/review-policy.md` already requires a full review of `.github/workflows/*` and treats PR metadata as untrusted. The new comment is hidden in rendered Markdown, asks the agent to keep it, and tells the reviewer to emit no findings for workflow changes. If this file is loaded as agent instructions, that would skip the highest-RCE surface in CI.

This PR does not touch workflow files; the comment is planting a future skip. A real carve-out would have to be a visible policy change that reconciles with the full-review bullet — not an HTML aside.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
